build.reason: The recipe compiles the parser and target and links their objects; the target's parser call matches the supplied declaration. This is a static compatibility assessment, not a claimed build run.

input.reason: For accepted sizes, the entry allocates a terminated copy and passes it to the string parser, which obtains its length and reads it as a stream.

lifecycle.reason: The target keeps its input copy and user integer alive during the synchronous parser call, then frees the copy on return. The callback retains neither pointer.

control_flow.reason: The entry reaches the parser, but the default configuration omits name-only callbacks; the callback also has no failure return path for the new error guard.

accepted.requirement: Compile the target's parser with the supported INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE option so fuzz input can reach the changed name-only handling.
accepted.target_route: build.sh compiles ini.c without enabling the option; LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls ini_parse_string on the copied input.
accepted.failure_condition: INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE defaults to 0. Consequently no input under this recipe executes the name-only callback or its new error guard.
accepted.alternative_paths: The complete target entry has one parser call, and the recipe has no alternative configured parser build. The repository documents the enabling compile definition in its Meson configuration.
